name: side bend
description: A Pilates side bend from a seated or side-supported position that works the obliques and the sides of the trunk.
instructions: Sit tall on your side with your bottom hand pressed into the mat and your legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a long diagonal line.
Reach your top arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting arm.
Lift back up to the long line while keeping your hips high.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.
